Long-haul fleet

Starting in 2025, SWISS will gradually introduce ten brand-new Airbus A350-900 aircraft. Together with the twelve proven Boeing 777-300ERs, fourteen Airbus A330-300s, and four Airbus A340-300s, SWISS offers maximum comfort, safety, and an exceptional flight experience on long-haul routes.

{spacer-25}

Airbus A350

From 2025, SWISS will successively introduce ten brand-new aircraft of the modern, highly economical and efficient Airbus A350-900 type – a further major step in the modernization of its long-haul fleet.

SWISS Senses

The innovative SWISS Senses cabin interior redefines the flying experience in all classes of the A350: more seating comfort, additional privacy, state-of-the-art on-board technologies and sophisticated products and services.

SWISS Wanderlust

The special livery of the very first SWISS Airbus A350 with the name “SWISS Wanderlust” is a tribute to Switzerland. Creative, playful and full of stories.

More about the A350

State-of-the-art cabin technology, even more facts and figures and a look behind the scenes of the creation of the first SWISS Airbus A350.

Boeing 777-300ER

The Boeing 777-300ER is SWISS’s biggest long-haul aircraft and is used in particular on ultra-long-haul routes. SWISS put the first brand-new aircraft of this type into operation in 2016.

On-board entertainment

Internet on board; a large selection of films, music and games and digital reading pleasure – the time will fly.
